response.justification: The candidate lacks the core embedded C experience for LAN-switch security products, with no demonstrable work in kernel development, networking hardware, or security features. While experienced in full-stack and high-performance systems, their background in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and Dlang does not align with the embedded C and Linux kernel requirements. Native Japanese proficiency is also unverified.
strengths: Strong software development experience across multiple languages and domains
Demonstrated ability to work with high-performance systems and real-time applications
Experience with Linux systems and open-source contributions
concerns: No direct experience with embedded C programming for networking hardware
Lacks evidence of Linux kernel modification or security feature development
Unclear Japanese language proficiency and minimal networking/security domain experience

key_factors.factor: Embedded C and Linux kernel experience
